defects.expected: Missing/invalid provider claims cannot use registered-only legacy grants
defects.actual: Complete valid global-word create succeeded with missing claim
defects.cause: isRegisteredUser treated missing firebase/provider as registered
defects.fix: Require explicit map, nonempty string provider, nonanonymous identity; field guest sync unchanged

defects.expected: Clients cannot grant legacy scores or purchases
defects.actual: Profile score update, state score create, exact-price atomic purchase succeeded
defects.cause: Bounded client score fields and atomic debit were mistaken for trusted earning authority
defects.fix: Profile-only affected keys; wallpaper-only state mutations; client purchases denied. Preserve trusted score fields on profile edits.

diagnostics.detail: First claim test lacked required word fields and passed for the wrong reason. Replaced with complete valid payload before second red run, which demonstrated missing-claim bypass. No acceptance reduction.

Initial scoped reads included absent functions, test/security/package.json and test/cli paths. Switched to rg file inventory and actual root package.json/tool/cli/tests; functions exist only in frozen main donor. No user files modified or removed.

@firebase/util createMockUserToken inserts firebase.sign_in_provider=custom for empty options. First post-fix run179/180 exposed this test issue, not a rule bypass. Explicit firebase:undefined omits the JWT claim; final180/180 passed. Empty map, empty/nonstring/anonymous provider also denied.
